# Shipaton Budapest

> A static archive for Budapest Shipaton editions, including local event details, schedules, speakers, and attendance information.

## Pages

- [Shipaton Budapest 2026](https://shipaton-budapest.pages.dev/2026/): Current Budapest edition overview.
- [2026 events](https://shipaton-budapest.pages.dev/2026/events/): Event archive for the 2026 edition.
- [Project Kickoff](https://shipaton-budapest.pages.dev/2026/events/project-kickoff/): Details, agenda, speakers, and attendance information for the kickoff event.
